description: We must always stand with Israel and the Jewish People. Somber but Beautiful Yom HaZikaron event. (Memorial Day) We pause to Honor & Remember the 764 Israel Soldiers & Police Officers & 834 Victims of Terror -including 29 Americans - who have made the ultimate sacrifice since October 7. These fallen Israeli soldiers were brave…
title: We Must Always Stand with Israel – Rey Martinez- GA State Rep – District 111
